scope: Small implementation; no live game startup or browser interaction in this agent validation. Main will validate the stable candidate via the actual CMD entry.

launcher.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; ASCII-compatible command syntax
launcher.failure: preserves Python exit code and pauses on nonzero exit; does not install dependencies or kill port occupants

dev_option: --open-browser opens only after both backend and frontend health checks return HTTP 200; open failure prints manual URL and leaves supervised services running.

checks.command: AST parse scripts/dev.py; verify launcher UTF-8/no-BOM/CRLF
Bind one ephemeral localhost port, invoke scripts.dev using that port as backend, then release socket
checks.result: expected occupied/unavailable message; no service launched

not_run: No actual game services started; Main will exercise CMD entry and HTTP readiness.
No dependency installation, environment/database access, paid calls, or Git commands.
limitations: This local smoke does not validate Windows Explorer double-click behavior or actual browser opening; awaiting Main’s stable-candidate check.
